<!-- Generated by scripts/check-upstream.mjs; edit source inputs and regenerate. -->

固定来源为 [Semi Design 2.103.0](https://github.com/DouyinFE/semi-design/tree/8bed560dd3f36579f85b7a522f19762f2bace756)，commit `8bed560dd3f36579f85b7a522f19762f2bace756`。以下数量由固定源码和当前包入口生成：83 个模块族、130 个根具名导出，当前同名根导出 31 个，完整公共模块交付 22 个、公共模块行为验收 22 个。

模块族只统计根入口相对导出的首层非内部目录。BaseComponent、BaseFoundation、semiGlobal 和外部 AI 数据函数另列根导出，不凑入模块族。计数不是行为覆盖率。

“设施/夹具”列登记实际源码、样式或测试支持，不等于完整组件。资源包装和语言字典的交付不自动成为组件验收。

## 已记录的接受映射

### avatar（已验收）

- API：Fixed Avatar defaults, image fallback/error decision, text geometry, size/shape/color, hover/top/bottom/border and Group count/overlap contracts, adapted to single-owner native slots and instance registration with explicit runtime safety and lifecycle differences.
- 类型：Native AvatarProps/AvatarGroupProps and original shape/size/color aliases are public. ReactNode renderers become synchronous native content; Group restAvatars becomes readonly descriptors. React AvatarState and Foundation AvatarAdapter remain internal, without a fictitious public instance API.
- 静态成员：Avatar retains **SemiComponentName** and elementType='Avatar'; the fixed source has no Avatar.Group. AvatarGroup has component metadata only and no public imperative methods.
- 子路径：Browser root named Avatar/AvatarGroup and avatar default/named entries, avatar/avatarGroup default/named, CSS/SCSS exports. Node root excludes both. Legacy React lib/es/lib/cjs paths are not mirrored.
- 决定：The fixed Avatar and AvatarGroup browser contracts are accepted for native Vapor with owned content, instance registration, image revisions, text geometry and explicit runtime safety. Border custom-style propagation, managed image callback validation and focus cleanup on native-node replacement are verified by regression tests and independent review. Strict declarations, per-source four-dimensional coverage, Chinese documentation, complete browser regression and four isolated tarball consumers passed full local verification. No other public family or additional environment support is accepted.

### badge（已验收）

- API：固定count/dot/type/theme/position/overflowCount/style/className/children/countClassName/countStyle及三个mouse回调映射原生Vapor。count与承载children独立；无默认99，0阈值禁截断；默认位置动态继承ConfigProvider direction，显式位置不镜像。
- 类型：BadgeProps使用原生CSS/HTML属性和MouseEvent；ReactNode映射BadgeContent同步factory，BadgeSlots仅default，类型只在badge子路径公开。保留上游数值边界与安全可表达的类型外计算；不承诺React类型同构。
- 静态成员：无Badge静态子组件或公开命令式方法；React类实例不映射为Vapor公共代理。
- 子路径：浏览器root具名Badge；./badge提供default/Badge与类型。固定上游legacy lib/es入口映射为短子路径，不提供其CJS或SSR承诺。
- 决定：Native Vapor Badge is accepted after fixed-source API audit, strict source and emitted declarations, ownership and lifecycle regressions, full browser documentation and E2E checks, four isolated tarball consumers, styles and provenance, three Badge DCE modes and independent review. Explicit native slot, renderer realm and peer-install boundaries remain.

### button（已验收）

- API：Native button/reset/submit, visual type/theme/size/block/circle/colorful, icon position and padding, loading/disabled precedence and native event identity are mapped through Button → IconButton/private BaseButton. Global defaults and group own-key ordering follow the fixed React defaultProps/clone behavior. Group cooperation uses direct DOM registration; Split tracks native descendants with nested ownership and cleanup, with the exact migration differences recorded in limitations.
- 类型：ButtonProps and mapped BaseButtonProps use Vue button attributes, native event parameters, scalar text and VaporRenderResult slots. HtmlType/Size/Theme/Type/HorizontalPaddingType are button-subpath types, and each group subpath exports its Props/Slots (ButtonGroup also Theme). Runtime BaseButton stays private. React children/icon node props, arbitrary Group events, static Button.Group and global slot configuration are rejected.
- 静态成员：Button preserves elementType="Button" and **SemiComponentName**="Button". No static Group or SplitButtonGroup exists upstream or in this implementation; framework defaultProps/propTypes metadata is replaced by native typed resolution.
- 子路径：Vue exposes the browser root plus explicit button, button/buttonGroup and button/splitButtonGroup entries and button CSS/SCSS; upstream lib/es and lib/cjs paths remain unsupported.
- 决定：The native Vapor Button, ButtonGroup and SplitButtonGroup browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream source with explicit DOM child registration, slot forwarding and nested split ownership differences. Source and generated declarations, pure Vapor and separate Vue interop behavior, lifecycle cleanup, live Chinese documentation, themed styles and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed verification and independent review. BaseButton remains a private runtime leaf, and acceptance does not extend to other public families.

### collapsible（已验收）

- API：Fixed controlled isOpen and all duration/motion/keepDOM/lazyRender/collapseHeight/adaptive/fade/reCalcKey/class/style/id/onMotionEnd fields; Vue native attrs and owned default slot; explicit cancellation/reduced/no-event differences.
- 类型：CollapsibleProps uses Vue HTMLAttributes and synchronous CollapsibleSlots; explicit undefined restores effective defaults; private React state and Foundation internals remain private.
- 静态成员：**SemiComponentName** and getEntryInfo preserved; no static subcomponent or imperative ref. React defaultProps/getDerivedStateFromProps are runtime adaptation internals.
- 子路径：Browser root plus default/named semi-ui-vue/collapsible, paired CSS/SCSS; Node root excludes public components. No legacy React lib/es/lib/cjs mirroring.
- 决定：The complete fixed browser Collapsible contract is accepted as native Vapor with an owned default slot and private native state. Controlled defaults, measured heights, retention, final caller CSS timing, rapid reversal, zero/no-event settlement, reduced motion and teardown have explicit source, strict declarations, real browser and documentation evidence. Complete local verify, four isolated tarball consumer flows, per-source four-dimensional coverage and production audit passed independent review. React lifecycle/ref, cancellation, ARIA responsibility and environment differences remain explicit. This decision accepts only local browser Collapsible behavior; no other family, SSR, hydration, CJS, publication or pixel-parity acceptance.

### configProvider（已验收）

- API：六props与静态默认断点图、两个订阅重载保留；嵌套继承、稳定wrapper、启用和map刷新通知及失效保护为Vue差异。
- 类型：ConfigProviderProps/ConfigContextValue、Readonly Ref scoped slot与响应式类型明确映射，不暴露React类型。
- 静态成员：ConfigProvider.defaultResponsiveMap 与子路径命名defaultResponsiveMap同一只读对象；无静态子组件。
- 子路径：浏览器UI根提供ConfigProvider/ConfigConsumer/useConfigContext；./configProvider提供default与命名组件、defaultResponsiveMap及类型。Node根保留静态设施。固定上游legacy子路径无exports map，不虚构结构化子路径。
- 决定：The public ConfigProvider and ConfigConsumer browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit native Vapor slot, own-key inheritance, stable DOM wrapper and responsive lifecycle differences. Source and generated declaration checks, browser and documentation behavior, pure Vapor and separate interop tarball consumers, and resource cleanup passed independent review. Locale data is forwarded through the existing context; public locale components remain outside this acceptance.

### divider（已验收）

- API：Fixed layout, align, margin, dashed, className and style are mapped to native Vapor props and a default slot. Numeric margin is px on the layout axis with style taking precedence; explicit undefined restores defaults. Native DOM attributes and events are forwarded without replacing owned children.
- 类型：DividerProps retains fixed property unions with Vue HTML attributes and StyleValue. ReactNode children becomes a VaporRenderResult default slot; unsafe DOM replacement, invented static/global APIs and root DividerProps are rejected.
- 静态成员：The fixed upstream functional Divider has no public static member or imperative component handle; none is added.
- 子路径：The browser root exposes Divider; the divider subpath exposes default/named Divider and DividerProps/DividerSlots. CSS and Sass use the exact fixed two-file Divider closure.
- 决定：The native Vapor Divider browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream source with explicit rendered-DOM slot classification, stable content outlet and Vue attribute/style differences. Strict source and generated declarations, pure Vapor and separate interop behavior, lifecycle cleanup, themed Chinese documentation and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed local verification and independent implementation review. The component creates no Foundation instance or global configuration defaults; acceptance does not extend to other public families.

### empty（已验收）

- API：Empty preserves fixed layout, content truthiness, URL/symbol/custom illustrations, mount-gated body theme observation and root data attributes without a default illustration or additional public family.
- 类型：EmptyProps and native slot/renderer/image types replace ReactNode and CSS types on ./empty; default slots represent children.
- 静态成员：No static child components or public imperative methods. React class implementation fields are not exposed.
- 子路径：Browser root Empty; ./empty provides default/named Empty and public types. Node root excludes the component; legacy React lib/es/lib/cjs paths are not reproduced.
- 决定：The fixed Empty contract is accepted with explicit native slot and synchronous renderer ownership, mount-gated body theme observation, URL/symbol illustration semantics, data-attribute filtering and no default illustration or public imperative API. Source and strict declarations, lifecycle and DOM identity tests, themed Chinese documentation, four isolated tarball consumer flows, tree-shaking and existing-family regressions passed; the implementation and its documented differences were independently reviewed.

### grid（已验收）

- API：Fixed Row type=flex, align, justify, gutter, prefixCls, className and native attrs map to one Vapor row root. Col span, order, offset, push, pull, xs through xxl, prefixCls and attrs map to one Vapor column root. Default slot replaces React children; own Row context carries reactive gutter to direct or nested columns.
- 类型：RowProps, ColProps, ColSize, Breakpoint and Gutter map at ./grid with Vue HTMLAttributes and native Vapor slots. Upstream RowContextType and RowState are internal and are not exposed. Number and breakpoint-object gutters, including a two-axis pair, follow fixed source contracts.
- 静态成员：Fixed upstream Row and Col have no public static members or imperative handles; none are added.
- 子路径：Browser root exports named Row and Col; ./grid exports both values and public types. Aggregate styles and ./styles/components/grid CSS/SCSS are available. Node root remains infrastructure-only and legacy React lib/es or lib/cjs paths are not Vue entries.
- 决定：Row and Col native Vapor browser contracts are accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 grid source, declarations, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Responsive class rules, fixed viewport breakpoints, both gutter axes, alignment, nesting, dynamic slot ownership, RTL and cleanup were tested in Chromium. Source and emitted declarations, documentation, four isolated tarball consumers, pure Vapor and separate interop execution, and independent full-file review support local delivery. No Layout, Skeleton, date picker or further component family is implied.

### highlight（已验收）

- API：Seven upstream props; sourceString defaults empty, searchWords defaults empty, autoEscape true, caseSensitive false and component mark. Unmatched substrings are native text nodes, matched chunks use the selected tag with semi-highlight-tag and global/keyword class/style precedence. No wrapper, attrs forwarding, slots, events, expose, statics or ConfigProvider/default registry. Private pure matching follows fixed Foundation UTF-16/regex/adjacent and overlapping interval rules. Native Vue createFor uses chunk.start keys and private Vapor Chunk/Mark components; no vue-jsx runtime For or VDOM code is introduced.
- 类型：HighlightProps is exported only from ./highlight; keyword objects retain text/className/string-valued style and the upstream declared-but-runtime-invalid undefined member. CSSProperties is Vue-native and React types are not exposed. No new public matcher or Foundation type re-exports.
- 静态成员：Highlight has no public static children, helpers or exposed imperative methods.
- 子路径：Browser root exports only Highlight; ./highlight exports default/named Highlight and HighlightProps. Aggregate and on-demand CSS/SCSS use the two pinned Foundation sources. Node root stays infrastructure-only; no CJS or legacy React deep-path aliases.
- 决定：Native Vapor Highlight is accepted against the fixed UI, Foundation matching algorithm and Chinese documentation contract. Source and strict declarations, differential and browser behavior, documentation examples, per-file coverage, package provenance and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed and were independently reviewed. Wrapper-free text roots and the explicit script/style tag rejection are documented; no other public family is accepted by this decision.

### iconButton（已验收）

- API：原生 button/content 结构、图标位置、padding、尺寸/theme/type/block/circle/colorful、loading与disabled优先级、原生表单和事件；children以text/default slot映射，icon以readonly fill作用域slot映射。保留iconSize/iconStyle no-op和分层默认值及prefix限制。
- 类型：IconButtonProps继承Vue原生button属性并区分视觉type/htmlType；IconButtonSlots、IconButtonIconScope和HorizontalPaddingType支持原生Vapor块、只读fill与明确undefined。BaseButton内部声明依赖不是公开出口。
- 静态成员：仅保留elementType = IconButton；无静态子组件、公开实例方法或全局defaults入口。
- 子路径：浏览器根具名IconButton与./iconButton默认/具名同一实现；CSS/SCSS为styles/components/iconButton。固定上游lib/es及lib/cjs旧路径不提供；Node根排除组件和私有BaseButton/Button组。
- 决定：Accepted the fixed upstream IconButton browser contract implemented with native Vapor slots and a private BaseButton. Strict source/generated declarations, native events and forms, lifecycle and animation cleanup, themed documentation, per-file coverage, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed local verification and independent source review. Explicit API and environment differences remain documented; this does not deliver public Button or group components.

### icons（已验收）

- API：Icon span 包装、六种 size、spin、整数 rotate、prefixCls/type/class/style/native attrs 已映射；React svg 节点改为 svg/default slot，fill 由调用方显式读取，ref 改为 getElement()，convertIcon 接收同一 SVG slot 工厂。ARIA 默认装饰性，有名称时为 img；显式 role/aria-hidden 优先。
- 类型：IconProps 映射为 Vue HTMLAttributes、只读 fill、IconSlots 和 IconHandle；另提供 IconSize、IconSvgScope、ConvertedIconProps。源/声明正反类型与实际 tarball 消费验证，不宣称 React 类型同构。
- 静态成员：Icon 与 convertIcon 结果提供 elementType = Icon，无静态子组件。固定上游的动态赋值 marker 不在 AST 静态成员索引中，人工契约和浏览器/类型测试覆盖。
- 子路径：浏览器 semi-icons-vue 根及 ./Icon 提供 default/Icon/convertIcon；semi-ui-vue 根提供具名 Icon，./icons 另提供 default。Node import 的 UI 根仅静态工具且声明一致。固定上游 icons 使用 legacy main/module/types，无 exports map，故不虚构结构化子路径映射；不提供 CJS、SSR 或 hydration。
- 决定：The public Icon browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit Vue slot/ref/ARIA and environment differences. Source and declaration checks, pure Vapor and separate interop browser behavior, documentation examples, package provenance, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed; the cited contract and evidence were independently reviewed. Acceptance of other public families is recorded independently.

### layout（已验收）

- API：Fixed Layout hasSider, tagName, prefixCls, className and style map to a native Vapor root with Header, Footer, Content and Sider static members. Sider breakpoint and onBreakpoint report fixed media matches without automatic collapse. Default slots replace React children; native attributes are forwarded only where the fixed component renders them.
- 类型：Upstream BasicProps, BasicLayoutProps, SiderProps and ResponsiveMap map to ./layout public types with native Vapor slots and Vue style/class types. Upstream BasicLayoutState and ContextType remain internal; LayoutBreakpoint and slot types are Vue-specific.
- 静态成员：The fixed Layout class exposes Header, Footer, Content and Sider as static subcomponents. Only Layout is a root named value export; there are no independent root Header, Footer, Content or Sider values.
- 子路径：Browser root exports Layout and ./layout exposes default/named Layout plus public types. Fixed React lib/es and lib/cjs deep paths are not Vue entries. Aggregate and standalone Layout CSS/SCSS use the pinned two-source Foundation closure.
- 决定：The native Vapor Layout and static Header, Footer, Content and Sider browser contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Dynamic Sider registration, explicit hasSider behavior, slots, root tags, breakpoint notifications, RTL and narrow-screen geometry, strict source/emitted declarations, four isolated tarball consumers and nine-family regression passed the complete local verify run (566 Vitest across 86 files, 59 website browser checks and 59 harness E2E). Independent stage-1 and stage-2 review found no unresolved actionable issues. Explicit React-to-Vapor and browser-only limits remain recorded below; acceptance does not extend to other public component families.

Native Vapor scoped slots, explicit dictionary-key generics, independent locale/config contexts and their differences are documented. Strict source and generated declarations, dynamic and isolated browser behavior, live documentation, all 57 generated dictionaries and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed verification and independent implementation review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

Renderer, slot, integer-width, event ordering, safe input, shared scroll fallback ownership and environment differences remain explicit. This decision accepts only OverflowList local browser behavior; no other family, component SSR/hydration, CJS, publication or full pixel-equivalence acceptance.

### popover（已验收）

- API：Native Vapor Popover wraps the same Tooltip Foundation, overlay and motion lifecycle. Fixed Popover defaults, card structure, arrow styling, visibility commands, notification order, focus and role rules are retained. Explicit scoped native trigger refs and owned content slots replace React child cloning; primitive synchronous content callbacks retain the Tooltip adaptation boundary. The named ArrowStyle helper is not exported; arrowStyle remains the fixed structural field of PopoverProps and ArrowProps.
- 类型：PopoverProps and ArrowProps map fixed source inputs to readonly Vue props and native callback/slot contracts; PopoverState retains the unused upstream exported type only. Element|null JSX ref entry types require same-realm current-document HTMLElement targets. Position uses the sixteen Tooltip type/Foundation branches; Popover PropTypes lists fourteen and Chinese docs twelve.
- 静态成员：Popover has no public static child component. **SemiComponentName** retains Popover metadata; React contextType is replaced by existing Vue context. The public instance provides focusTrigger only, with Foundation returnFocusOnClose/non-custom rules. An explicit valid call may focus its connected native trigger while its own popup remains open; it does not override a higher nested focus owner.
- 子路径：The fixed upstream root exposes only the Popover value. The Vue browser root additionally exports seven type-only declarations: the three fixed component type concepts and four strict native slot/trigger/instance adaptations. ./popover exposes default/named Popover and those public types plus five shared Tooltip types. Node root remains infrastructure-only; fixed CSS/SCSS entries use the configurable theme prefix. No upstream React lib/es/lib/cjs component paths or CJS/SSR/hydration acceptance.
- 决定：The fixed browser Popover wrapper contract is accepted over the existing Tooltip Foundation, G11 resource/event and G12 motion facilities. Native refs and owned slots replace React child cloning; synchronous primitive callbacks, exact defaults, controlled rules, native event order, geometry, focus/ARIA and teardown have explicit source and runtime evidence. Strict declarations, current live Chinese documentation/E2E and four actual isolated tarball consumer flows passed independent review. The recorded type, slot, native realm, animation/style and environment differences remain explicit; no other public family is accepted by this decision.

### skeleton（已验收）

- API：Skeleton loading defaults true, active adds the animation class, placeholder and children become named/default native Vapor slots, and only the loading branch has a semi-skeleton div with x-semi-prop=placeholder. Avatar, Title, Button, Paragraph and Image are static placeholder members. Root class/style/native attributes apply to the loading div, while real content is returned without a wrapper. Standalone item defaults, dynamic rows and CSS geometry follow the fixed source.
- 类型：SkeletonProps, AvatarProps, ParagraphProps, GenericProps and source item BasicProps map to ./skeleton with Vue HTML attributes and native Vapor slots; SkeletonSlots and SkeletonAvatarSize are explicit Vue types. ReactNode props are rejected, and root only exports the Skeleton value.
- 静态成员：The fixed Skeleton class exposes Avatar, Title, Button, Paragraph and Image static subcomponents. No independent root values for these placeholder pieces are added.
- 子路径：Browser root exports Skeleton; ./skeleton exports default/named Skeleton and public types. Aggregate and standalone CSS/SCSS use the pinned four-source Foundation closure. Fixed React lib/es and lib/cjs deep paths are not Vue entries; Node root remains infrastructure-only.
- 决定：The native Vapor Skeleton and five static placeholder subcomponents are accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Loading branch ownership, dynamic slots and props, standalone items, CSS animation, strict source and emitted declarations, live examples, Chromium behavior and three direct Skeleton tarball consumer surfaces plus a fourth Foundation regression flow passed local verification and independent review. React-to-Vapor differences and browser-only limits remain explicit; this decision does not accept independent Avatar, Typography, Image or other public families.

### space（已验收）

- API：Fixed vertical, wrap, align, spacing, className and style map to one native Vapor inline-flex root and a default slot. Explicit undefined restores defaults. Named tokens and numeric gaps preserve upstream axis and inline-style precedence; native attributes and Vue class are supplemental.
- 类型：Align, Spacing and SpaceProps retain fixed unions and Spacing[] array length. ReactNode children become SpaceSlots.default returning VaporRenderResult, with Vue HTMLAttributes and StyleValue. Unsafe DOM replacement and invented Space layout APIs are rejected.
- 静态成员：The fixed upstream Space class exposes no public static child component or imperative handle; none is added.
- 子路径：The browser root exposes the Space value; ./space exposes default/named Space plus Align, Spacing, SpaceProps and SpaceSlots. Fixed Space CSS/SCSS is available standalone and in the aggregate. Legacy React lib/es and lib/cjs paths are not Vue entries.
- 决定：The native Vapor Space contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source and styles. Direction, wrap suppression, alignment, named and numeric two-axis gaps, native slot ownership, dynamic keyed children, type surfaces and CSS/RTL behavior were checked in real browsers. Strict source and emitted declarations, documentation, pure Vapor and separate interop execution, four isolated tarball consumer flows and independent change review support delivery. No Foundation state machine, global Space defaults or additional public component family is implied.

### spin（已验收）

- API：三尺寸、spinning/delay、文本tip、wrapperClassName/childStyle和遮罩保留来源语义；React节点改原生default/indicator/tip slots。初次truthy delay仍可立即显示；后续取消、延迟重配和过期回调由既有scope管理。default slot存在决定block。根仅转发声明的class/style、role/ARIA/data；无事件、model或公开实例方法。
- 类型：SpinProps/SpinSize映射固定来源；VaporRenderResult slots、StyleValue与有限DOM属性替代ReactNode/CSSProperties。SpinSlots是新增Vue类型。正反例覆盖原始文本/null/Promise slot与不支持属性边界。
- 静态成员：保留只读Spin.**SemiComponentName** = Spin；无静态子组件。getDerivedStateFromProps是React生命周期，不作为公开静态API导出；默认值通过实例配置解析与Vue响应式状态实现。
- 子路径：浏览器根具名Spin/types；semi-ui-vue/spin提供default/named Spin与types。Node根仅静态设施。上游./lib/es/spin、./lib/es/spin/icon、./lib/es/spin/icon.js、./lib/es/spin/index和./lib/es/spin/index.js未作为兼容路径公开；内部icon与状态机不导出。无CJS、组件SSR或水合。
- 决定：The public Spin browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream defaults, derived loading state, DOM and styles. Native Vapor slot and attribute differences, instance-scoped delay cancellation, global-default edge cases, source/generated declarations, live documentation, Chromium behavior and four isolated tarball consumers passed complete local verification and independent review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

### tag（已验收）

- API：Fixed Tag color/size/shape/avatar/defaults/visibility/close and keyboard contracts, TagGroup list/callback/count/Popover behavior, and SplitTagGroup direct siblings are mapped to native Vapor-owned content and actual DOM coordination. Tag captures configured defaults per instance; interactive callback identity is compared with that captured default.
- 类型：Native TagProps, discriminated TagGroupProps, SplitTagGroupProps and the fixed TagColor/TagSize/TagType/TagShape/AvatarShape aliases; ReactNode becomes scalar data or synchronous owned native content. Native event types include KeyboardEvent in close/click and optional tagKey, reflecting actual behavior. TagState and React instance internals remain private.
- 静态成员：Tag retains `__SemiComponentName__`="Tag" only. The fixed source has no Tag.Group, Tag.TagGroup or Tag.SplitTagGroup static public subcomponents; Group and Split are independent exports without new ref methods.
- 子路径：Browser root named Tag/TagGroup/SplitTagGroup; tag default/named/aggregate types, tag/group default/named, tag/splitTagGroup default/named, tag/interface types, and CSS/SCSS style exports. Node root excludes all three component values; legacy lib/es/lib/cjs paths are not mirrored. The split subpath is an explicit native packaging adaptation.
- 决定：Accepted native Tag, TagGroup and SplitTagGroup with owned native content, fixed close and keyboard behavior, count-based folding and direct DOM split boundaries. Root and subpath Tag-only consumers discard unused Group and Popover implementations; Group consumers retain them. Initial split marker ownership is preserved without inferring later ownership transfer. Strict declarations, actual tarball consumers, source coverage and browser checks pass within the recorded renderer and installation limits.

### tooltip（已验收）

- API：Fixed five trigger modes, sixteen positions, controlled visibility, delayed hover, container/context selection, Foundation positioning, overflow/spacing/margin/arrow, outside/Escape/focus and close lifecycle fields. Native default trigger slot explicitly binds attrs, triggerProps and native callback refs; content and custom arrow use owned slots. Instance exposes focusTrigger, rePosition and getPopupId. No disabled prop, automatic child cloning or additional public family. TooltipTriggerProps provides optional mouse/focus/keyboard callbacks declared as Pick over common native event fields, required tabIndex and data-popupid; caller event composition invokes the internal callback and then its business callback. Trigger refs and keyed refs support only HTMLElement/null in the Tooltip creation document and realm; Element|null is the pinned JSX callback entry signature, not an SVG/MathML/component/foreign-realm compatibility promise.
- 类型：TooltipProps, Trigger, Position, ArrowBounding, RenderContentProps and RenderContent are mapped to ./tooltip with Vue CSSProperties and native events. RenderContent is primitive-only; rich content uses TooltipSlots. TooltipInstance, TooltipTriggerScope, TooltipTriggerProps, TooltipNativeRef and TooltipPrimitive are Vue-specific subpath types. React generic RefObject/ReactNode and private state/adapter types are not exported as compatibility promises. TooltipTriggerProps onKeydown also uses common KeyboardEvent fields, while component onEscKeyDown/onClickOutSide retain complete native event types. class retains Vue HTMLAttributes class wide boundary; optional props explicitly allow undefined. initialFocusRef shares the Element|null entry signature but requires a focusable HTMLElement in that same document and realm; it does not guarantee every HTML element is focusable.
- 静态成员：Fixed **SemiComponentName** and contextType are framework metadata, not static child components. The candidate exposes no static subcomponent or class instance state.
- 子路径：Browser root provides Tooltip value only. ./tooltip provides default/named Tooltip and public types. Existing aggregate and standalone Tooltip CSS/SCSS sources are reused. Node root remains infrastructure-only; React legacy deep paths, CJS and component SSR/hydration are unsupported. The production Tooltip-only Foundation/es-toolkit inline closure is an internal package provenance profile, not a runtime dependency or public subpath.
- 决定：The public Tooltip browser contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 with five triggers, sixteen positions, initialization-time defaults, Foundation visibility and geometry, native trigger ownership, primitive callbacks and owned content/arrow slots. Strict source/generated declarations, full per-file coverage, documentation/E2E, real CSS motion and four isolated tarball consumers passed with pure Vapor and ordinary Vue interop checked separately. Explicit HTML/document/ref, event, content, environment and installation differences remain recorded; no additional public family or runtime dependency is accepted.

### typography（已验收）

- API：Typography container and the fixed Text/Title/Paragraph/Numeral API are adapted to native owned slots/renderers; scalar ellipsis, copy, formatting, decorations and semantic roots retain audited defaults and explicit boundary differences.
- 类型：Public aliases map native DOM events, CSS and synchronous renderer ownership; React internal states and nodes do not imply public native instances. Component types live on the typography family or leaf subpaths, not additional root short names.
- 静态成员：Typography.Text, Typography.Title, Typography.Paragraph and Typography.Numeral retain their component identities; no other public static API is introduced.
- 子路径：Browser root Typography; typography default/named; four lower-case leaf default/named entries. Node root excludes the family. Legacy React lib/es/lib/cjs paths are not mirrored.
- 决定：Accept the reviewed native Typography family with explicit native content ownership, fixed string ellipsis and copy semantics, official numeral formatting, strict browser package surfaces and documented adaptation boundaries. No additional public families or runtime compatibility targets are introduced.

## API、类型与路径差异

当前 `semiGlobal` 是 Vue 初始化默认值设施；没有 React `createRoot`，默认值捕获时机也不同。同名不代表 API 或行为对齐。各族 API、类型、静态成员与子路径映射由显式接受记录单独说明；未接受的条目仍需逐项交付。

可提交的 `resources/upstream/baseline.json` 记录上游每个输入的指纹、类型语法、静态成员、子路径和资源；`matrix.json` 另列当前根值/类型导出、六包导出条件与资源支持范围。类型语法指纹用于发现变化，不代表 React 类型已转成 Vue 类型，也不证明语义兼容。动态构造的静态 API 保留解析限制，需要人工复核。当前不提供上游的 React `lib/es` / `lib/cjs` 路径或公共组件 CJS。

[资源索引](./resource-index.md)、[本地产物与消费方式](./packages.md)和[兼容边界](./compatibility.md)分别说明已交付资源、ESM/声明、纯 Vapor 与 interop、严格安装与 SSR 限制。
